engine: SQLite STRICT ANY (in-memory native SQLite driver)
case: grouped SUM() result storage classes through typed CSV re-import
contract: Grouped SUM(value) over STRICT ANY returns INTEGER for integer inputs and numeric integer text, REAL for real inputs, numeric real text, and mixed integer/real inputs, and SQL NULL when every input is NULL.
Nonnumeric text and BLOB inputs follow SQLite SUM coercion and produce REAL 0.0; source typeof() and explicit expected values pin this behavior.
Typed CSV export/import restores each computed result carrier into STRICT ANY, verified by native typeof() and exact values.
Summing 9223372036854775807 and 1 returns SQLite's integer overflow error instead of silently promoting the integer result.

native_contract_group.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-app sqlite_ -- --test-threads=1

clippy.command: rtk proxy cargo clippy --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-app --all-targets -- -D warnings
